note: Local coder models for PACER coding. Court text never leaves the machine: models run through a local Ollama server and are pinned by content digest; the coder refuses a model whose digest differs. Pull with `ollama pull <name>`; weights live in Ollama's store (~/.ollama), not in the repository.

runtime.start: env $(the env above) ollama serve   # a dedicated server for this pipeline; one model in memory at a time
runtime.note: two requests in flight on a 16 GB machine: four were barely faster on real filings and added about 2.5 GB of KV cache

coder_A.why: best accuracy of the candidates on dev cases (event F1 0.87, action 0.91) at 7.9 s per page

coder_B.why: a second model family (Llama), so the coders do not share errors; 7.1 s per page

selection.how: python -m state_machines.coding.select_models on dev cases synth_001-005 (held-out never used)

rejected.qwen3:8b: 29.6 s/page, event F1 0.80: slower and not better
rejected.llama3.1:8b: about 50 s/page under prompt 1.1: too slow on 16 GB
